cli.usage:
ifs-bruno — Generate Bruno collections from IFS Cloud OData projections

Usage:
cli.usage_init:
ifs-bruno init
    Create a new Bruno collection folder pre-configured for IFS Cloud auth.
    Options (all optional — prompts will ask for missing values):
      --name <name>        Collection name and output folder  [default: IFS]
      --host <url>         IFS Cloud base URL  e.g. https://acme.ifs.cloud
      --realm <realm>      Keycloak realm name
      --client-id <id>     OAuth2 client ID  e.g. IFS_postman
      --output <folder>    Output folder path  [default: same as --name]
cli.usage_add_spec:
ifs-bruno add --spec <path.json> --collection <folder>
    Add endpoints from a local Swagger 2.0 JSON file to a Bruno collection.
      --spec <path>        [required]  Path to a local Swagger 2.0 JSON spec file
      --collection <dir>   [required]  Bruno collection folder (created by ifs-bruno init)
cli.usage_add_profile:
ifs-bruno add --profile <name> --collection <folder>
    Connect to IFS Cloud, browse projections, and add endpoints interactively.
      --profile <name>     [required]  Saved profile name (created by ifs-bruno profile add)
      --collection <dir>   [required]  Bruno collection folder (created by ifs-bruno init)
cli.usage_profile_add:
ifs-bruno profile add [<name>] [options]
    Save an IFS Cloud connection profile (host, realm, client credentials).
    Profiles are stored at ~/.ifs-bruno/config.json
    Options (all optional — prompts will ask for missing values):
      --host <url>                  IFS Cloud base URL  e.g. https://acme.ifs.cloud
      --realm <realm>               Keycloak realm name
      --client-id <id>              OAuth2 client ID  e.g. IFS_postman
      --client-secret <secret>      OAuth2 client secret
      --keycloak-base-path <path>   Keycloak base path  [default: /auth]
cli.usage_profile_list:
ifs-bruno profile list
    List all saved profiles.
cli.usage_profile_delete:
ifs-bruno profile delete <name>
    Delete a saved profile.
